'''2002 MegaCon tournament''' was a constructed Star Wars CCG tournament at MegaCon 2002 in Orlando, Florida. MegaCon ran 22–24 February 2002 at the Orange County Convention Center.<ref name="wp-megacon">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MegaCon MegaCon], Wikipedia (MegaCon 2002: 22–24 February 2002, Orange County Convention Center).</ref> [[Sean Weigold]] finished 2nd.<ref name="dt-21525">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21525 Hidden Bothan Version 1 1], DeckTech (Sean "einnobevoli" Weigold, 18 February 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/21525/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/21525/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 22–24 February 2002
* '''Site:''' MegaCon, Orange County Convention Center, Orlando, Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]

The dates are the convention's. Weigold did not say which day the tournament was played.<ref name="dt-21525" />
